overall: The AG found the Seekonk Veterans Memorial Park Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve minutes for six 2016 meetings, and ordered compliance and creation of those minutes within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee did not create and approve minutes for several meetings in 2016, and did not provide them when requested.
allegations.key_passage: After consulting with the Committee's legal counsel, it appears that the Committee did not create and approve minutes for the meetings held on January 12; February 16; March 1,15, and 29; and May 10, 2016.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, create and approve minutes of the six meetings addressed in the letter, to the best of its ability.
Notify the AG's office of compliance in writing upon completion, per 940 CMR 29.07(4).
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. Further, we order the Committee, within thirty (30) days from receipt of this letter, to create and approve minutes of the six meetings addressed in this letter, to the best of its ability.
